source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 2 Properties
source.quote: Our corporate headquarters are located in Menlo Park, California, where we currently have lease commitments for multiple facilities with various expiration dates through 2036.

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Business
source.quote: This drove our decision to open an office in Singapore as our APAC headquarters.

notes: Robinhood's FY2025 10-K gives no customers, assets, employees or offices by state, country or region: it reports approximately 2,900 full-time employees at Dec 31, 2025 in total, says it leases office facilities "throughout the United States and other countries around the world", and that it serves the U.K. (brokerage) and select EU jurisdictions (crypto, via Robinhood Europe, UAB, regulated by the Bank of Lithuania). No company-published state or country impact report was found. Only sites are recorded, all re-sourced to the FY2025 10-K.
